content.summary: Investigated why Task tool shows 'Running' and never gets updated in Anthropic Agents SDK integration

data.root_cause: The Anthropic SDK may not be sending tool_use_summary events or they're not being parsed correctly

evidence.user_observation: Tool calls stuck on 'Running' until session stops, then marked 'aborted'

code_trace.claude-agent-sdk.ts: Lines 532-558: Handles tool_progress and tool_use_summary events
code_trace.processor.ts: Lines 172-198: Expects tool-result event to transition from 'running' to 'completed'
code_trace.processor.ts_cleanup: Lines 385-399: Sets incomplete tools to 'error' status with 'Tool execution aborted'

data.key_insight: The processSDKMessage() function in claude-agent-sdk.ts only emits tool-result when it receives 'tool_use_summary' with a summary field (line 541). If the SDK never sends this event, tools stay 'running'.

options.title: Add debug logging to trace SDK events
options.description: Add logging in processSDKMessage() to see exactly what events the SDK sends. This reveals whether tool_use_summary is missing, malformed, or has different field names.

options.title: Check SDK documentation and update event handling
options.description: Review @anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk docs to understand expected event types for MCP tool completion. May need to handle different event types or field names.

options.title: Fall back to assistant message tool completion
options.description: The SDK might report tool completion via the 'assistant' message content blocks rather than separate tool_use_summary events. Check if tool_use blocks in assistant messages include completion info.

data.recommendation: Option 1 first - add debug logging to understand exactly what events the SDK sends, then decide on fix approach
